knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

## Plane crash example

```{r}
year = 2025
crashurl = paste0('https://planecrashinfo.com/', year, '/', year, '.htm')
crashpage <- rvest::read_html(crashurl, encoding = "ISO-8859-1")

crashpage |>
  rvest::html_elements("td:nth-child(1) > font > a") |>
  rvest::html_text2() -> dates

crashpage |>
  rvest::html_elements("td:nth-child(2) > font") |>
  rvest::html_text2() -> loc_op

# Skipped column 3, identical, skipped for time reasons
crashpage |>
  rvest::html_elements("td:nth-child(4) > font") |>
  rvest::html_text2() -> fatalities

df = data.frame(dates = dates, fatalities = fatalities[-1], loc = loc_op[-1]) |>
  tidyr::separate(loc, into = c("location", "operator")) |>
  tidy::separate(fatalities, into = c("plant_fatalities", "pass", "ground_fatalities"))

dplyr::glimpse(df)
```
